cards.referenceText:
GPS stands for Global Positioning System. It is a part of GNSS.
GPS 是全球定位系统（Global Positioning System ）的缩写，它是 GNSS（全球导航卫星系统 ）的组成部分 。

Compared with conventional navigation, GPS is more reliable, more accurate, and safer.
与传统导航相比，GPS 更可靠、更精准且更安全 。

cards.audioText: How much do you know about GPS?
cards.referenceText:
As I know, GPS is the Global Positioning System. It is one of the most widely used global navigation satellite systems (GNSS).
据我所知，GPS 是全球定位系统（Global Positioning System ）。它是使用最广泛的全球导航卫星系统（GNSS ）之一 。。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer GPS or conventional navigation systems?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢GPS还是更喜欢传统导航系统？
cards.referenceText:
I prefer GPS because:
GPS can provide more precise guidance to the aircraft;
GPS can be used in all weather conditions;
GPS can be used all over the world.
我更喜欢 GPS ，原因如下：
GPS 能为飞机提供更精准的引导；
GPS 可在各类天气条件下使用；
GPS 可在全球范围内使用。

cards.audioText: If GPS fails during flight, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞行中GPS失效，你会怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
If GPS fails during flight, we will use conventional navigation systems such as VOR, NDB, and DME. Besides, we will report our situation to ATC and request radar monitoring and radar vectors.
如果飞行中GPS失效，我们将使用传统导航系统，比如VOR，NDB，DME。此外，我们将报告管制我们的情况，请求雷达监控和雷达引导。
